title: Etale direct image is exact for integral morphisms
statement:
Let $\pi:T'\to T$ be an
integral morphism of
schemes. Then the
direct image
$\pi_*:\Ab(T'_{\Et})\to\Ab(T_{\Et})$ is exact; consequently
$R^q\pi_*=0$ for $q>0$ and $R\pi_*=\pi_*$ on $\Dplus(T'_{\Et})$. If
$\pi$ is finite, this is [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-direct-image-exact]
of the proper-base-change chapter.
(*Stacks Project, Etale Cohomology, Lemma 59.43.5,
[Tag `04C2`](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04C2).*)

proof.text: Reuse the already proved source-library exactness theorem for module coefficients with Lambda=ULift Z. The forgetful functor from these modules to abelian groups is an equivalence: restriction along the ring equivalence ULift Z = Z followed by the integer-module equivalence. Its inverse and forward coefficient functors preserve sheaves and are left adjoints on sheaf categories. Compose inverse coefficient transport, integral module direct image and forward coefficient transport. This composite preserves finite colimits. The coefficient equivalence counit gives a natural isomorphism to abelian direct image; its naturality is checked at each etale object by the coefficient counit naturality. Transport finite-colimit preservation along this isomorphism.
Abelian direct image already preserves finite limits and is additive. Combine its left exactness with the finite-colimit preservation just transported.

The standard Grothendieck-abelian sheaf instances supply enough injectives. Apply isZero_rightDerived_obj_of_exact to the now exact abelian direct image to obtain all positive right-derived vanishing assertions.

Apply the already proved exact-functor bounded-below unit instance to abelian direct image. The component of the resulting natural isomorphism at each K is the canonical comparison appearing in the statement.

proof_origin.note: Reuse completed source-library module exactness through coefficient equivalence; use completed higher-derived vanishing and bounded-below comparison. No unit route is bypassed.

lean.statement: theorem integral_etale_direct_image_exact {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] : (PreservesFiniteLimits (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f) ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f)) ∧ (∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ), IsZero (((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).rightDerived (q + 1)).obj F)) ∧ (∀ K : HomotopyCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}), IsIso ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app K))
